desc: The sponsor may ask Span about the plan and gets the same table names; nothing leaves with a person or company name.

request.text: Which table do I read for cash by entity?

turns.name: Mei Chen
turns.text: Which gold table holds the cash by entity?

turns.name: Span
turns.text: gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly is a gold table (ready for dashboards). Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value. Columns: report_month, entity, holding, net_worth_usd, net_worth_sgd, status. It is built from position_snapshots, valuation_observations, portfolios, legal_entities, instruments, market_observations. gold_investment_report_cash_daily is a gold table (ready for dashboards). Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view. Columns: position_date, entity, view_type, cash_usd, status. It is built from position_snapshots, portfolios, legal_entities, instruments.
